findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/prep-attach.ts::the admissibility line adds one line, and spec_lines is a tier feature, so the spec's claim that the line changes no extractspecfeatures input is false at a size boundary
findings.title: the admissibility line adds one line, and spec_lines is a tier feature, so the spec's claim that the line changes no extractSpecFeatures input is false at a size boundary
findings.action: Stage re-tiers over the final text after inserting the line, so the recorded build-tier always equals faff tier on the file; the existing boundary test pins it.
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec deviation, fixed in the build: tier, then the admissibility line, then tier again over the final line count. The existing 'build-tier equals faff tier on the written file, across the spec_lines boundary' test passes with the extra line.

occurrences.title: the admissibility line adds one line, and spec_lines is a tier feature, so the spec's claim that the line changes no extractSpecFeatures input is false at a size boundary

findings.title: the tier-unchanged-by-the-line test is boundary-fragile
findings.action: Scoped the test title and comment to a fixture away from any tier cut; the boundary invariant stays pinned by the existing spec_lines boundary test.
findings.disposition_rationale: Valid: the comparison only isolates the line's content effect away from a tier cut. Test renamed and commented in 47a4464e; the recorded-tier-matches-file invariant is the boundary test's job.

findings.disposition_rationale: Inherent to prose producers and the spec's chosen advisory posture (§4.2): the mechanical check is the stage-time verdict every attach path computes; FAFF-1423 adds the autonomous-promotion refusal.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/prep-attach.ts::an indented admissibility: line survives the removal filter
findings.title: an indented admissibility: line survives the removal filter
findings.action: No change: the spec mandates a line-start match (§4.1) so prose or a DONE item containing the word is untouched, the same rule build-tier: uses.
findings.disposition_rationale: Stage only ever writes an unindented line, so a survivor needs a hand edit; widening the match would also strip legitimate indented content.

occurrences.title: an indented admissibility: line survives the removal filter

findings.disposition_rationale: Not a defect: the first call places the build-tier line the admissibility line anchors on; the second computes the tier over the final line count. A regression is caught by the spec_lines boundary test.
